Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh flash, film grain. Accent: electric green against near-black.

slides.headline: 1) HAVEIBEENPWNED: YOUR EMAIL WAS PROBABLY STOLEN
slides.body: Over 12 billion accounts have been exposed in data breaches. Go to haveibeenpwned.com, type your email, and it shows every company that leaked your data. If it comes up red, change that password tonight.
slides.image_prompt: Close on two hands typing at a glowing dark laptop screen, the display below the search bar flooding with cascading red warning triangles and breach-icon badges, no readable text. Crimson screen glow on knuckles. Documentary news photo, 35mm. Accent: crimson against charcoal.

slides.headline: 2) ALTERNATIVETO: FIND A CHEAPER VERSION OF ANY APP
slides.body: Go to alternativeto.net, type in any tool you currently pay for, and it returns every substitute ranked by real user votes. Most people find a subscription they can cut the same day.

slides.headline: 3) PHOTOPEA: FREE PHOTOSHOP IN YOUR BROWSER
slides.body: Adobe Photoshop charges $250 a year. Photopea opens PSD files, handles layers and masks, and runs in any browser for free. Go to photopea.com and you cannot tell the difference.

slides.headline: 4) REMOVE.BG: STRIP ANY BACKGROUND IN 5 SECONDS
slides.body: Product photographers charge $30 to $80 per image for clean cutouts. Remove.bg does it automatically, including hair and fine edges, and the transparent PNG downloads free. Go to remove.bg and upload your photo.
slides.image_prompt: Split-frame: left half shows a white sneaker on a cluttered table with a busy background; right half shows the identical sneaker razor-sharp against a clean transparent checkerboard, every edge perfect. A sharp dividing line runs down the center. Documentary news photo, 35mm. Accent: clean white against deep teal.

slides.headline: 5) VIRUSTOTAL: SCAN ANY FILE BEFORE YOU OPEN IT
slides.body: Go to virustotal.com, upload the file or paste the link, and 70 security engines check it simultaneously in under 10 seconds. Free, no account needed. Do this every time a stranger sends you anything.

slides.headline: 6) ILOVEPDF: EVERY PDF TOOL YOU WILL EVER NEED, FREE
slides.body: Adobe Acrobat charges over $150 a year. ilovepdf.com does all of that plus splitting, rotating, and Word conversion, completely free, no account required. Go to ilovepdf.com and bookmark it now.
